periods.time: vol-15 ch-003, first phase of the war

name.zh: 史黛菈击败约翰并由露娜艾丝救回他
name.en: Stella defeats John and Lunaeyes rescues him

periods.type: representative duel / puppet liberation / royal confession
periods.location: Skies over Luxel and ruined outskirts below
periods.summary: Stella stops puppet-controlled John's Golden Chariot by will and force, then Lunaeyes personally calls John back and helps him break Or-Gaule's control.
periods.cause: John, controlled by Or-Gaule and forced beyond his limits, intercepts Stella in the air while she is deciding whether to rescue Ikki from his fall.
periods.process: Stella trusts Ikki and focuses on John. She sees that Or-Gaule's puppet strings are making John's body bleed by forcing output beyond his normal ability. To end the fight quickly, she dismisses Lævateinn and faces Trampling King's Road barehanded. Because John's charge lacks his own will, Stella overpowers its fate-clearing concept, catches the lance, pulls him from the chariot, and delivers Lunaeyes's message with a full-force slap. The blow sends John into the outskirts and awakens memories of Lunaeyes's past discipline and promise. Lunaeyes appears despite being a noncombatant, reminds John she will share his burden, and calls him back. Or-Gaule tries to make John stab her, but John breaks the control at the last instant, switches the lance to phantom form, and suffers massive backlash instead of injuring her physically. Lunaeyes endures the phantom pain, embraces him, and promises to stay by him while he rebuilds Quedland.
periods.outcome: John collapses free of Or-Gaule's control and is evacuated with Lunaeyes. Stella confirms the rescue and turns her attention toward Or-Gaule.
periods.aftermath: Flashbacks reveal Lunaeyes renounced Vermillion succession with Sirius and Astrea's reluctant blessing so she could stand beside John.
periods.significance: Removes Quedland's puppet king from Or-Gaule's control, proves Stella's post-awakening will can overpower concept-level obstacles, and resolves Lunaeyes's personal choice.
